newsitem.title: UK: Dixons down as Laing advises trim holdings.
newsitem.headline: Dixons down as Laing advises trim holdings.

text.p: Shares in Dixons Group Plc dropped on Friday as analysts at Credit Lyonnais Laing advised investors to "top-slice" their holdings in the electrical retailer, traders said.
The stock was down 16p at 568 by 1210 GMT, after hitting a record 589p yesterday. Analysts at Laing were not immediately available for comment.

Other traders pointed out the stock had bounced back from the spell of profit-taking which dragged it lower at the end of September, as Standard Life reduced its stake and directors, including chairman Sir Stanley Kalms, cashed in options.
"It has had a stupendous run in the past few weeks," said one.
